frequency_question: How often does a scheduled monetary policy meeting result in a repo rate increase within a given quarter?
membership_rule: Members are quarterly monetary policy committee decisions from major emerging market central banks (e.g., RBI, Bank Indonesia, Banco Central do Brasil) during non-crisis normal operating environments. Excluded are emergency inter-meeting rate changes and deep crisis interventions.
coverage_note: 12 named meetings; representative of recent tightening and stabilization phases.
known_gaps: Does not account for idiosyncratic domestic political shocks or sudden global commodity price spikes.
skeleton: RBI bi-monthly monetary policy meetings over a normal multi-year policy cycle
multiplier: 12 meetings evaluated across 2022-2024 representing tightening and pausing phases
validity_reason: Central bank institutional frameworks and reaction functions evolve slowly over decades.
